user.title: Add Hive receiver
user.description: Hive Local looks up your Hive receivers in Zigbee2MQTT. Change the base topic only if you've changed it in Zigbee2MQTT.

device.title: Choose receiver
device.description: These are the Hive receivers Zigbee2MQTT knows about. Hot water is offered automatically on receivers that have it.

error.no_bridge: Zigbee2MQTT didn't send its device list. Check that MQTT is set up, Zigbee2MQTT is running, and the base topic is right.
error.no_receivers: Zigbee2MQTT has no Hive receivers that aren't already added.

boost_heating.name: Boost heating
boost_heating.description: Heat to a temperature for a number of minutes, then go back to the previous mode.

device_id.name: Receiver
device_id.description: Which receiver. Can be left out if you only have one.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to boost (1-360). Defaults to the boost duration setting.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature (5-32 °C). Defaults to the heating boost temperature setting.

boost_water.name: Boost hot water
boost_water.description: Turn the hot water on for a number of minutes.

device_id.name: Receiver
device_id.description: Which receiver. Can be left out if you only have one.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to boost (1-360). Defaults to the boost duration setting.

cancel_boost_heating.name: Cancel heating boost
cancel_boost_heating.description: End a heating boost and go back to the previous mode.

device_id.name: Receiver
device_id.description: Which receiver. Can be left out if you only have one.

cancel_boost_water.name: Cancel hot water boost
cancel_boost_water.description: End a hot water boost and go back to the previous mode.

device_id.name: Receiver
device_id.description: Which receiver. Can be left out if you only have one.
